question: India defeated which of the following countries in the ICC U19 World Cup final at the Sir Vivian Richards Stadium in Antigua on 5th February 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**England.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **India defeated England** by **four wickets** and won the **fifth world cup title** at the **Sir Vivian Richards Stadium, Antigua. **
 
• India had previously won the trophy in **2000, 2008, 2012, and 2018. **
 
• **Yash Dhull** became the **fifth Indian captain** to win the world cup title after **Mohammad Kaif, Virat Kohli, Unmukt Chand, and Prithvi Shaw.**
 
• 
 **Raj Angad Bawa** of India was the **Player of the Match** in the Final.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• South Africa’s **Dewald Brevis** broke all records to score **506 runs in six innings**, the **most for any batter in any Under19 World Cup,** and was named **Player of the Series.**
 
• **2022** **ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup** was held in the **West Indies** in January and February 2022.
